- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

113	func TestCacheConcurrency(t *testing.T) {
114		ctx := context.Background()
115		cache := NewDefault()
116		defer cache.Close()
117	
118		const goroutines = 10
119		const operationsPerGoroutine = 100
120	
121		var wg sync.WaitGroup
122		wg.Add(goroutines)
123	
124		for i := 0; i < goroutines; i++ {
125			go func(id int) {
126				defer wg.Done()
127	
128				baseKey := fmt.Sprintf("worker%d-", id)
129	
130				// Set operations
131				for j := 0; j < operationsPerGoroutine; j++ {
132					key := fmt.Sprintf("%skey%d", baseKey, j)
133					value := fmt.Sprintf("value%d-%d", id, j)
134					cache.Set(ctx, key, value)
135				}
136	
137				// Get operations
138				for j := 0; j < operationsPerGoroutine; j++ {
139					key := fmt.Sprintf("%skey%d", baseKey, j)
140					val, ok := cache.Get(ctx, key)
141					if !ok {
142						t.Errorf("Key '%s' should exist in cache", key)
143						continue
144					}
145					expected := fmt.Sprintf("value%d-%d", id, j)
146					if val != expected {
147						t.Errorf("For key '%s', expected '%s', got '%s'", key, expected, val)
148					}
149				}
150	
151				// Delete half the keys
152				for j := 0; j < operationsPerGoroutine/2; j++ {
153					key := fmt.Sprintf("%skey%d", baseKey, j)
154					cache.Delete(ctx, key)
155				}
156			}(i)
157		}
158	
159		wg.Wait()
160	
161		// Verify size and deletion
162		var totalKeysExpected int64 = goroutines * operationsPerGoroutine / 2

66	// Cache is a thread-safe in-memory cache with TTL and memory management.
67	type Cache struct {

75	// New creates a new memory cache with the given configuration.
76	func New(config Config) *Cache {

97	// SetWithTTL adds a value to the cache with a custom TTL.
98	func (c *Cache) SetWithTTL(_ context.Context, key string, value any, ttl time.Duration) {

100		size := estimateSize(value)

107			(&c.itemCount).Add(1)
108		}

199	// cleanupLoop periodically cleans up expired items.
200	func (c *Cache) cleanupLoop() {
201		ticker := time.NewTicker(c.config.CleanupInterval)

203			ticker.Stop()

207		for {

211			case <-c.stopChan:
212				return

214		}
215	}

217	// cleanup removes expired items.
218	func (c *Cache) cleanup() {
219		evicted := make(map[string]any)
220		count := 0
221	
222		c.data.Range(func(key, value any) bool {
223			itm, ok := value.(item)
224			if !ok {
225				return true
226			}
227			if time.Now().After(itm.expiration) {
228				c.data.Delete(key)
229				count++

231				if c.config.OnEviction != nil {
232					if keyStr, ok := key.(string); ok {

235				}
236			}
237			return true
238		})

240		if count > 0 {
241			(&c.itemCount).Add(-int64(count))

243			// Call eviction callbacks outside the loop to avoid blocking the range
244			if c.config.OnEviction != nil {
245				for k, v := range evicted {

252	// cleanupOldest removes the oldest items if we're over the max items.
253	func (c *Cache) cleanupOldest() {
254		// Remove 20% of max items at once
255		threshold := max(c.config.MaxItems/5, 1)
256	
257		currentCount := (&c.itemCount).Load()
258	
259		// If we're not over the threshold, don't do anything
260		if currentCount <= int64(c.config.MaxItems) {
261			return
262		}
263	
264		// Find the oldest items
265		type keyExpPair struct {
266			key        string
267			value      any
268			expiration time.Time
269		}
270		candidates := make([]keyExpPair, 0, threshold)

272		c.data.Range(func(key, value any) bool {

276			}

278				candidates = append(candidates, keyExpPair{keyStr, itm.value, itm.expiration})
279				return true
280			}
281	
282			// Find the newest item in candidates
283			newestIdx := 0
284			for i := 1; i < len(candidates); i++ {
285				if candidates[i].expiration.After(candidates[newestIdx].expiration) {

290			// Replace it if this item is older
291			if itm.expiration.Before(candidates[newestIdx].expiration) {
292				candidates[newestIdx] = keyExpPair{key.(string), itm.value, itm.expiration}
293			}
294	
295			return true
296		})

298		// Delete the oldest items
299		deletedCount := 0
300		for _, candidate := range candidates {
301			c.data.Delete(candidate.key)
302			deletedCount++
303	
304			if c.config.OnEviction != nil {
305				c.config.OnEviction(candidate.key, candidate.value)
306			}
307		}
308	
309		// Update count
310		if deletedCount > 0 {
311			(&c.itemCount).Add(-int64(deletedCount))

217	// cleanup removes expired items.
218	func (c *Cache) cleanup() {
219		evicted := make(map[string]any)
220		count := 0
221	
222		c.data.Range(func(key, value any) bool {
223			itm, ok := value.(item)
224			if !ok {

226			}
227			if time.Now().After(itm.expiration) {

253	func (c *Cache) cleanupOldest() {
254		// Remove 20% of max items at once
255		threshold := max(c.config.MaxItems/5, 1)

259		// If we're not over the threshold, don't do anything

262		}

265		type keyExpPair struct {

267			value      any

282			// Find the newest item in candidates
283			newestIdx := 0

307		}
308	
309		// Update count
310		if deletedCount > 0 {

124		for i := 0; i < goroutines; i++ {
125			go func(id int) {

130				// Set operations
